about.text: Jordan's hard, dry skimmed yogurt, made mainly from sheep's milk on a small scale. Traditionally the yogurt is churned to take off the butter, and the skimmed remainder is salted and dried. Market samples average about 85% solids and 16% salt, which lets it keep for months.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.label: churn, boil, dry
how.text: Jameed is the curd of churned sour yoghurt, strained, heavily salted and dried in the sun. Low moisture, low pH and high salt together let it keep for up to two years.

processing.text: Mostly sheep milk, weakly heated and soured by its own flora, then churned; the heated buttermilk curd is strained, salted and sun-dried.
